title_as_printed: Experimental data of CO2 solubility in pure water.

footnotes_as_printed: u(x) is the standard uncertainties of CO2 solubility.

pressure_note: column headed P/MPa; paper does not say whether total or CO2 partial; cell was pressurised with CO2 only; text refers to 'pressure' and to the water saturated vapour pressure only in the modelling section
notes: Temperature is printed only on the first row of each block; filled down in the CSV (SPEC v2.1 item 3). Printed block order kept (293.15, 323.15, 308.15, 348.15 K in Table 2). Solubility x = n_g/(n_l+n_g) from sampled liquid flashed at about 293.15 K and atmospheric pressure, gas volume measured by drainage and by GC. Some rows are at pressures where CO2 is liquid or supercritical (e.g. 293.15 K above 5.7 MPa, 308.15 K above ~7.2 MPa); not flagged as lle by the authors (water-rich liquid in equilibrium with CO2-rich phase); regime left empty.

row_regime_overrides.reason: 293.15 K above the CO2 vapour pressure (about 5.7 MPa): L(H2O)-L(CO2) region per the paper (audit 2026-10-02)
